profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a people-person who also loves math and clever algorithms. I started my career maintaining databases for Stanford and then Adobe. I have extensive leadership experience as a member of a board, university lecturer, and teacher of math and Python. I have a versatile skillset as I've picked up different frameworks over the years. I recently completed an ML bootcamp for tech professionals in which I've built multiple end-to-end projects, including MLOps tools. People say I am easy to work with, task-driven, and organized.
